introHtml: Orange bar wine items make a bold choice for promotional giveaways at college tailgates, fall festivals, or any event with a vibrant color scheme. Whether you choose a 10 oz vacuum insulated cup for hot coffee or cold drinks, the bright orange hue ensures your logo stands out. Screen printing or full-color wrap decoration works well on these items, giving you high visibility in any crowd.
